test_title: PYST 2: SSC GD Constable 2025 - Reasoning (Held On: 04 Feb, 2025 - Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each, in such a way that there is equal distance between adjacent persons.

In row 1 – I, N, K and S are seated and all of them are facing south

In row 2 – P, A, R and T are seated and all of them are facing north.

Thus, each person faces another person from the other row.

R sits to the immediate right of A. Only two people sit between K and S. A faces K. The one who faces N, sits to the immediate left of P.

T doesn’t sit at any of the extreme ends. Which of the following options represents both people facing each other?
solution:
Given, Eight people are sitting in two parallel rows containing 4 people each,

In row 1 – I, N, K and S are seated and all of them are facing south.

In row 2 – P, A, R and T are seated and all of them are facing north.

Only two people sit between K and S.

A faces K.

R sits to the immediate right of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea43b75ac7e8054c35035080d2564d63c9f6b5b5a913ad073bca0b26a2d6561f.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95845fda00ff236c156eedd7787f75c061f4b04b67039884ce942581abfc4c2e.png] 

T doesn’t sit at any of the extreme ends.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b17003bc364aef3b92f2085e3ad387113665f536fe1f99aef8e195ccea4de16a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d867cd37cd7f6d73963f4a026c2f0d898d5562c1160feb02fee847fd1c249d57.png] 

The one who faces N, sits to the immediate left of P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e0fd23824a5d32380b51907be320112754057540b765fb62fdbc10d00642ec43.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/855762ef580155a9858e1eddce9c17ce5b29cdba3ac2afb6ef69dd7a22b17cc2.png] 

And I sit at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4df2982f8fb9d1e37048939784ee526ba5e53be7c65cd07701b43e78f3f1505a.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf6d8d4a43921c8708ed3e1c80bb4a57d94dfec049b4f4c7a31cc33e600e89b5.png] 

From the diagram, I and R are facing each other

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1.**"
